glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 囗 (“closure”) + phonetic 或.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 國 (或 → 玉). Also compare 囯, an unorthodox variant of 國 that contains 王* (“king”) instead of 玉* (“jade”).
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 國; s_page_origin explains the simplified 国.
